dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can we do in the Easybreeze Market?

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: Rest, load up on wonderful local wares, enjoy great food, and admire the colorful streets... If you want to kick back even more, you can take it all in from the comfort of a couch.

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: Or, you could spend the whole day chatting with "Teteltetl"!

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: I ohoho-hope you enjoy your refreshing summer holiday!
